title: Server constants observed live
detail: party_cap=5, world_cap=10, roster_cap=30, tick_seconds=0.25, idle_recall_ticks=2000, max_stat=24, move_stamina=20, item_stamina=10, ride_stamina=12, ride_max_tiles=8. Maps: vale 72x200, mines 64x176, spire 56x208; 4 bands each, spawn_max_y=8.
evidence: hello_ok config dumped from the live server (guild g_cd0e2a), 2026-08-16.

title: Monster-part essences are fixed (not shuffled per world)
detail: venom_sac -> venom, ectoplasm -> aether, bone -> vigor. Universal, so they are calibration points when a world's herb->essence mapping is unknown.
evidence: Manual/AGENTS.md states these are fixed freebies; to re-confirm in play.

title: explorer/0.1.0 plays cleanly live (0 action errors)
detail: 60-tick pre-flight: recruited to world_cap, armed up (buy/sell), embarked evenly (vale:4/mines:3/spire:3). But ~26% of moves failed.
evidence: pre-flight run_id 1, 2026-08-17: buy5/embark10/move36/recruit10/sell5; action_error_rate 0.0; events move_failed=10 vs move=28.

title: move_failed concentrates early and near spawn/edges
detail: REFUTED: the ~50% failures were not spawn/edge proximity. Root cause was a pathfinder bug (routing onto solid 'frontier' walls) plus stepping onto monster tiles. Fixed in explorer/0.2.0; see 'BUG (fixed): pathfinder routed onto solid frontier walls'.
test: Correlate move_failed positions with y and with tiles-known-count at that tick; expect concentration at low known-count / low y. Falsified if move_failed is uniform across the map and run age.

title: Each world's herb->essence mapping is shuffled; must be learned
detail: CONFIRMED + partially decoded for THIS world from 34 brews (see the essence-map discovery). Mechanic holds; vigor and venom pinned, off-axis herbs partially placed.
test: taste one herb (destructive) to read its essence, or brew a known-majority pot and read result/tells; build a per-world herb->essence table. Falsified if tastes show a stable cross-world map.
evidence: run #8, 34 mapped brews; vigor/venom pinned by curdle pattern

title: First improvement: smarter movement fallback to cut move_failed
detail: Shipped in explorer/0.2.0 (nav wall-frontier fix + monster-tile blocking + destination reservation). Confirmed: move_failed 55%->0.8%.

title: Specialize per map once recipes/enemies are learned
detail: vale=brewing, mines=forging, spire=magic. Once each world's ingredient/flux/recipe vocabulary is known, consider dedicating parties to each map's crafting pillar rather than uniform exploring.

title: explorer/0.1.0: ~50% of moves fail (move_failed) and drive stamina exhaustion
detail: Over a ~10.8k-tick live window: move_failed=19276 vs move=18742 (~half fail); action_error_rate 9.9% dominated by not_enough_stamina=3185. Failed moves still cost stamina, cascading into unaffordable-action errors.
evidence: guild_log.db run #2 @ tick ~10791: events move/move_failed, action_errors GROUP BY reason.

title: Monster tiles block movement but baseline paths onto them
detail: The baseline keeps monster tiles walkable (to attack on contact) and does not add them to the pathing blocked-set, so it steps onto monsters and bounces (move_failed) whenever a monster sits on a path but is not the current adjacency-attack target.
test: explorer/0.2.0 blocks monster tiles in pathing (attack when adjacent, route around otherwise); expect move_failed rate to drop sharply in the next window. Falsified if move_failed stays ~50% after the change.

title: BUG (fixed): pathfinder routed onto solid "frontier" walls
detail: nav.bfs_step allowed stepping onto a GOAL tile even if it was a known-solid wall; nav.frontier counted a wall bordering the unseen as an exploration target. So the explorer repeatedly targeted wall tiles and walked into them -> move_failed. Likely a major share of the ~50% failed-move rate. Fixed: goal special-case now excludes known-solid tiles; frontier requires a standable tile. Surfaced by mutation-checking the destination-reservation test.
evidence: Reproduced in a unit scenario: bfs_step onto a wall goal returned a step; now returns None. tests/test_nav.py covers it.

title: UI: metric time-series graphs with per-version overlay
detail: Line charts of gold/hr, xp/hr, deaths, move_failed rate and action-error rate over ticks, with run-window (version) bands/overlays so a deploy s before/after is visible at a glance. Directly supports the loop s own measurement. Likely the next UI build.

title: UI: map heatmaps (deaths, loot density, move_failed hotspots)
detail: Overlay toggles on the pan/zoom map: where characters die, where loot/gold concentrates, and where moves bounce — practical for spotting bad terrain/pathing and fun to watch accumulate.

title: UI: live roster panel — what each character is doing now
detail: A per-character strip (hp/stamina/carry, current world+pos, last chosen action + one-line reasoning), updating live, so the guild is legible at a glance without scrolling the decision feed.

title: UI: knowledge tables as we learn content
detail: Render learned game content as it accumulates — per-world herb->essence mappings, craft tell correlations, enemy/loot sightings — sourced from findings.jsonl + guild_log.db.

title: Live bot is detached from the Claude session (cap-resilient)
detail: redeploy.sh launches run-live.sh via daemon(8)/setsid, reparented to init, so a Claude usage cap (or session end) pauses the improvement loop but not the game bot.
evidence: Process chain for steemer.runner roots at PID 1 (daemon 8147 <- init) after the detached relaunch, run #4.

title: Auto-sense Claude usage % to self-throttle without operator input
detail: Superseded in practice by the periodic operator usage check-in (loop_config.json mode + a periodic AskUserQuestion). True auto-sensing stays a nice-to-have only if a readable quota signal ever appears; none exists today.

title: CONFIRMED: explorer/0.2.0 cut move_failed 55%->0.8%, action-errors 8.5%->3.9%
detail: The nav wall-frontier fix (plus monster-block + reservation + affordability) near-eliminated bounced moves and more than halved the action-error rate. Remaining top error: not_enough_stamina (still ~3.6% of actions) -> next target. New small error kinds: no_such_character/unknown_character (acting on a recalled/dead char), no_such_item.
evidence: guild_log.db by strategy_version: move_failed 29847/53836=55.4% -> 464/56434=0.8%; action_errors 3951/46586=8.5% -> 1889/49054=3.9%.

title: Death diagnosis: died-on-arrival on spire, poisoned, no stamina to flee
detail: 306 char-deaths/984 recruits=0.31; 74% on spire (hardest map) but shallow (median y12) and fast (76% within ~200 ticks of embark); ~22% HP at death; 35% actively poisoned; 45% of hurt-decisions rested (couldn't afford the step home). Two dead safety valves: potions never bought (0/36 carried) and spend_xp never called (max_hp frozen at 24-30). Spire got 74% of embark slots via a self-reinforcing funnel.
evidence: Analysis subagent read-only over guild_log.db (run windows for explorer/0.2.0); see decisions.log 'Iteration 2'.

title: spend_xp for durability — shipped in explorer/0.4.0
detail: spend_xp VIT>END>STR (toward cap 8, gifts halved) shipped in explorer/0.4.0. The spire embark-share de-funnel was NOT included — tracked separately as an open consideration.

title: FIXED: /api/snapshot ~25s -> ~instant (missing run_id indexes + full village-frame decompress)
detail: At 121k frames/193k events/302k decisions (~916MiB), metrics._run_summaries full-scanned the big tables (no run_id index) and _run_gold_delta decompressed all 31,366 village frames per call. Fix: run_id/grouping indexes (SCHEMA + applied live), O(1) gold-delta (first+last village frame), and a ~3s TTL cache in the UI. 25s->1.78s cold / ~1.5ms warm.
evidence: RCA subagent timings: _run_summaries 16.8s of 18.3s; per-run COUNT frames 7.3s, gold-delta blob fetch 7.9s + decompress 2.25s; after fix snapshot 1.57s local / 1.78s cold via UI.

title: Bound the frames table's disk growth without losing per-run history
detail: frames is ~916MiB and grows ~unbounded; prune_frames exists but nothing calls it, and naive pruning breaks _run_gold_delta / per-run counts for old runs. Materialize a small per-run summary (gold first/last, counts) at run close, THEN prune old raw frames. Not urgent for speed (indexes make snapshot fast at any size); it's a disk concern.

title: Iteration 2 CONFIRMED on survival RATE (-43%); poison is now the dominant hazard
detail: explorer/0.3.0 vs 0.2.0: our-deaths/1k ticks 12.68->7.28 (-43%). deaths/recruit (0.32) is a poor oracle (deaths drive ~1:1 refill recruits). status_damage/1k rose 90->254 because chars now survive-while-poisoned (flee+drink: 55 potion buys, 81 uses) instead of dying. Next: spend_xp into VIT/END to tank/outrun poison.
evidence: Per-version aggregation over guild_log.db events joined to runs; run #5 buy-kind breakdown {club:7, potion_red:55}, use=81.

title: explorer/0.4.0 deployed: spend_xp now active (VIT>END>STR toward 8, gifts halved)
detail: Village now spends banked XP on durability. Measure next window: distribution of max_hp among living characters (baseline 24-30) and death rate (deaths/1k ticks, baseline 7.28 on 0.3.0).
evidence: explorer/0.4.0 gated (77 tests) and hot-redeployed as run #6.

title: Cap spire's embark share / gate spire on character level
detail: Deferred from iteration 3. Spire got 74% of embark slots via a self-reinforcing funnel (dies fastest -> fewest fielded -> refilled first). Cap its share and only send leveled chars there, now that durability (0.4.0) has landed.

title: BUG (fixed 0.5.0): equip never fired — chars fought bare-handed and unarmored
detail: The village sold gear before the equip step (equip count = 0 across all history) and had no path to equip looted armor/shields. Fixed: equip into empty slots before selling, learning slots from wrong_slot/stat_requirement. Likely a major hidden contributor to the death/poison problem (no armor = full damage).
evidence: actions_sent action='equip' count = 0 over the whole DB; sample field chars carried pickaxe/gear with all equipment slots None.

title: Add an equip-rate metric (% of fielded chars wearing weapon + armor)
detail: Track in metrics/analyze so gear coverage is visible; baseline ~0% pre-0.5.0. Also surface on the UI.

title: CONFIRMED: equipping works live (0.5.0) — but gear supply is now the bottleneck
detail: run #7: equip fired and succeeded (an 'equipped' event; a char wields a pickaxe) vs 0 equips ever before. Equip-rate still ~10% weapon / 0% armor — not an equip failure but supply: fresh recruits carry nothing, they're broke (~36g), and they equip weak tools (pickaxe) for lack of a real weapon.
evidence: actions_sent equip=1 (run7) + 'equip' event=1; field sample ~10% hand-equipped, 0% outfit.

title: Shop stock: no buyable body armor; shield_wood is the only buyable defense
detail: Shop sells weapons (dagger15/club15/shortsword45/spear70/bow85/bomb60), pickaxe40, sickle35, shield_wood25 (offhand), potions (red20/blue18), vial_green15, bottle_empty2, striders90 (likely boots), fickle_pearl30 (likely trinket), tome_veil120 + tome_bolt150 (magic). Outfit/body armor is NOT for sale -> must be looted. Buyable defense = shield_wood (offhand); boots via striders.
evidence: shop.stock from a live village frame (run #7).

title: Iteration 5: buy defense (shield_wood offhand) + prefer a real weapon over a tool
detail: Since armor isn't buyable, buy shield_wood (offhand, 25g) for the only shop-buyable damage reduction; consider striders (boots) when richer. Don't let equipping a weak tool (pickaxe) block acquiring a proper weapon. Body armor comes only from loot, so keep looted 'outfit' gear and equip it.

title: Guild encounters crafting/magic content constantly but uses NONE of it
detail: Seen: 184 herb + 165 crop + 47 ore-vein + 58 track tiles, chests/safes, 4 portals, 1 cauldron. Carried: brewables (bitterroot, frostmoss, bone[=vigor], ectoplasm[=aether]), forge stock (gem_rough, ore), food (berries/egg/meat/tomato), looted gear incl armor (knight_bare) + trinkets (sun_charm/moon_charm) + boots (skimmers/striders). Tomes buyable. Yet brew/smelt/forge/taste/cast actions = 0 across all history. The bot is at the survive+explore tier only.
evidence: tiles_seen kinds; inventory scan of 300 frames; actions_sent brew/smelt/forge/taste/cast all 0.

title: Arc: brewing experimentation -> better potions (learn herb->essence + tells)
detail: Deliberate taste/brew loop at cauldrons: calibrate with fixed monster parts (bone=vigor, ectoplasm=aether), brew small combos with bottle_empty, log tells+products, and have the analysis subagent infer this world's herb->essence map + recipe tiers. Payoff: elixirs stronger than shop potions (survival).

title: Arc: forging -> the ARMOR supply answer (no armor is buyable)
detail: Mine ore veins (47 seen) with a pickaxe, smelt 2 ore->ingot at a forge, forge weapons/armor (+lumber, +flux like gem_rough). Body armor is not for sale, so forging is the only route to 'outfit' armor beyond rare loot. Learn per-metal flux by experiment (tells).

title: Arc: magic/spellweaving -> directly kills the poison problem
detail: Buy/loot tomes (tome_veil 120, tome_bolt 150) to learn forms; attune essences via focus ingredients from brewing; map the per-world weave circle by reading resound/fray. clarity purges hostile workings (poison!), vigor mends (heal). This is the spire's pillar and the direct counter to the status_damage that now dominates deaths.

title: Use carried food for field sustain (finite heal reserve)
detail: Chars carry berries/egg/meat/tomato (uses=drink) but rarely eat them; foraging crops (165 tiles) + eating extends the finite field-heal reserve so parties last longer per expedition.

title: Survival arc 0.3->0.5 measured: deaths/1k -28%, poison -48%, 41% now armed; armor still 0%
detail: 0.3.0->0.5.0: deaths/1k 6.44->4.66, status_damage/1k 256->134, weapon-equip 0%->41%, spend_xp 0->75, survivor max_hp 30->66. Equip + spend_xp fixes are landing. Unclosed gaps: armor 0% (not buyable -> forging), median max_hp still 30 (recruits die young), poison ~134/1k (-> magic clarity). Data says forging is the top remaining durability lever.
evidence: Per-run aggregation over guild_log.db (runs #5/#6/#7).

title: Live-verify explorer/0.6.0 brewing (new action type)
detail: CONFIRMED live: 11 brews, 0 brew errors; produced potion_red x5 + potion_gold x1, 6 murky/curdled failures (50%); tells flowing. Brewing works; no rollback. Next: infer herb->essence from ingredient/product/tell correlation.

title: Brewing works live: potions produced (incl potion_gold combo); 4 tells observed
detail: run #8: 6 brewed (potion_red x5, potion_gold x1) / 6 failed (murky, curdled) = 50%. Tells: dark_sheen(5), pale_crust(2), acrid_smoke(1), sweet_mist(1). brew_started carries only a timer (ticks:10); ingredient correlation must come from the brew action's item_ids + inventory.
evidence: events run_id=8 kind in (brewed, brew_failed, brew_started); brewed payloads show item+tier+tells.

title: Infer this world's herb->essence map by correlating brews (analysis subagent)
detail: Done: analysis subagent decoded the map from run #8 brews. Results recorded as the essence-map / product / tells discoveries.

title: Minor: 7 'move' actions rejected not_in_village
detail: A character exiting to the village (move S off row 0) with a queued move gets not_in_village. Low impact; guard by not issuing field moves for a char whose frame world flipped to village, or just accept it.

evidence: run #8 (git a44958d), 34 mapped brews; all 7 curdles were vigor+venom pairs
title: Brewing essence map (this world): vigor OPPOSED venom; embercap=vigor, moonbell=venom
detail: Circle axis: vigor <-> venom are directly opposed (all 7 observed curdles were vigor+venom, nothing else). Confirmed: bone=vigor, venom_sac=venom, ectoplasm=aether (fixed calibration); embercap=VIGOR (HIGH; 'ember' name is a red herring); moonbell=VENOM (HIGH); potion_red re-brews as vigor. Off-axis (ember/frost/clarity/aether), partially placed: glimmerweed ~adjacent venom, bitterroot ~adjacent vigor, fickle_pearl likely aether (blink_dust), frostmoss + sungrass distance-2 (unplaced).

evidence: run #8, product frequencies vs ingredient sets across 34 brews
title: Brew product -> essence/effect (this world)
detail: potion_red=vigor/heal (HIGH); flask_green=venom majority (HIGH); vial_green=venom combine (glimmerweed+venom_sac); potion_gold=vigor combine (bitterroot+embercap); flask_orange=frostmoss's off-axis essence; blink_dust~aether (glimmerweed+fickle_pearl, 'blink'). Higher tier from more/agreeing ingredients.

evidence: run #8 tell frequencies per ingredient across 34 brews
title: Tells are per-INGREDIENT: pale_crust=sungrass/frostmoss, sweet_mist=bitterroot, dark_sheen=noise
detail: pale_crust -> sungrass(9/9)/frostmoss(7/8); sweet_mist -> bitterroot(7/7)+fickle_pearl; acrid_smoke -> embercap/moonbell/potion_blue; dark_sheen fires on 32/34 brews (near-universal) => treat as NOISE, not diagnostic.

title: Iteration next: essence-AWARE brewing (stop curdling; target vigor healing)
detail: Blind brewing curdles ~50% by mixing vigor+venom. Encode the learned essence map as DATA the strategy reads (not hardcoded logic), brew SAME-essence groups (never mix vigor+venom), and target vigor (bone/embercap/potion_red) for reliable potion_red healing at higher tier. Also `taste` unknown off-axis herbs to complete the map. Dual-use: essence knowledge feeds M4 magic attunement (focus ingredients).

title: Watch: essence-aware brewing may strand minority-essence herbs
detail: _should_sell keeps all `brew` items, and _choose_brew only brews same-essence batches of >=2. A char carrying e.g. 1 vigor + 1 venom herb can now brew NEITHER (declining to curdle) and won't sell them -> they occupy carry cap and can trip the 'pack full -> go home' branch. Watch carry-full frequency + un-brewable-herb accumulation next window; if it regresses, add: sell the excess of the minority essence once a same-essence batch has been brewed. [CONFIRMED run #9: held 0.49->1.83, full-carry 0%->14.5%, move/stamina errors 7.5%->17.7%. FIXED in v0.8.0: stranded brewables are now sold, not hoarded.]

evidence: run #9: 3 brew_failed events, 2 'curdled' + 1 'murky', all with the pale_crust tell (=> an undecoded off-axis herb present); no decoded vigor/venom batch curdled
title: Undecoded off-axis herbs are NOT all one essence — blind-mixing them curdles
detail: The off-axis herbs (sungrass/frostmoss/glimmerweed/bitterroot/fickle_pearl) span multiple essences (ember/frost/clarity/aether), so v0.7.0's 'brew all-unknown herbs together' learning batch conflicts and curdles. 'curdled' == essence conflict by definition, so this confirms >=2 distinct essences among the undecoded set. Clean single-essence brewing of the DECODED herbs (vigor->potion_red, venom->flask_green) succeeded in the same window.

title: v0.8.0: learn undecoded herbs by taste / same-KIND brew, not blind-mixed batches
detail: v0.7.0 learns unknowns by mixing them, which curdles (wastes ingredients) and doesn't cleanly attribute an essence. Refine: for undecoded ingredients, prefer (a) `taste` a single herb (destructive but definitive -> essence directly), or (b) a batch of >=2 of the SAME kind (cannot curdle -> product reveals that kind's essence). This completes this world's essence map with far less waste and feeds M4 magic attunement (focus ingredients need known essences). Also record potion_blue/potion_yellow as new products to place. [v0.8.0 shipped the same-KIND-batch half (no more mixed-unknown curdles). The `taste`-to-learn half is deferred to v0.9.0 — see the new consideration.]

evidence: sampled 400 field frames/run: run#8 avg_brew_held=0.49 full=0.0%; run#9 avg_brew_held=1.83 full=14.5%; not_enough_stamina/move 7.5%->17.7% of actions
title: Hoarding un-brewable ingredients fills carry and stalls chars (move/stamina errors)
detail: Brew ingredients kept but never brewable accumulate in inventory, fill carry cap, and make chars repeatedly attempt (and fail on stamina) to walk home to sell. The lever is to SELL what can't be brewed. Generalizes: any 'keep for later' item class needs a drain, or it becomes carry debt.

title: v0.9.0: taste stranded undecoded singletons instead of selling them
detail: v0.8.0 sells undecoded singletons (unclogs carry) but that discards a learning opportunity. v0.9.0: `taste` a lone undecoded herb (destructive, definitive -> its essence directly) before selling, and fold the result into knowledge.ESSENCE so future brews can batch it. Completes this world's essence map fastest and feeds M4 magic attunement. Needs: parse the taste result event -> update the (in-memory + persisted) essence map.

evidence: run #9 stopped_at stayed NULL after run #10 (0.8.0) superseded it during hot-redeploy
title: Hot-redeploy hard-kills the outgoing runner, so end_run() is skipped
detail: The zero-downtime handoff supersedes the old session server-side and the supervisor swap kills the old process before its kick handler/end_run runs. Any cleanup that must happen on the OLD runner's shutdown is unreliable; make the NEW runner responsible instead (begin_run now closes dangling windows). Same lesson applies to any future 'flush on shutdown' logic.
